resources.string: Makes the remote\'s Home button open Clean Home TV instead of the Google TV home screen. It only watches the Home key and which app is on screen. Nothing is read, stored or sent anywhere.
Hold OK on an app to add it to or remove it from your home screen.
Select the pencil at the top left to choose your apps
Tick the apps to show on your home screen. On the home screen, hold OK on an app and choose Move, then use the arrows to put it where you want.
